name: windstack-sdk

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/evm packages/solana packages/vexanium packages/wallet-plugin-wisp packages/session
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/evm packages/solana packages/vexanium packages/wallet-plugin-wisp packages/session --pretty
scripts.test: node scripts/test-signing.mjs && node scripts/test-provider-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-sdk-behavior.mjs
scripts.validate: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run pack:dry-run

author: PT WIND KRIPTOGRAFI TEKNOLOGI
description: TypeScript SDK packages for Wind Stack, Wisp Wallet, Wind Explorer, and Vexanium dApps.
